title: Every draw of the L4 retail fold, with the metric each one was actually scored at
note: The four draws behind §AUDIT 34.201's pooled 194 trials. Two of them were never committed as pair artefacts, which is why the pooled rates could not be re-run from the repository; both have since been recovered from the runs that wrote them (run 44363599721 and run 44395483632, artefact `pair-artefact-official`) and committed verbatim under `eval/results/`. The `k` column is the level each draw was scored at and it does not come from the pair artefact — none of these four was written with one — but from the registration header that fed `TAU_TRIALS` (`trials: 1` in all four) and, for the two recovered draws, from the arm artefact's own `metrics.k` read out of the run's evidence bundle.
